_comment: Capability-root manifest for compute/ (ADR-0562). Every crate and accounting count below was read off the tree at authoring time, not transcribed from legacy microservices/ paths.

substrate_dag_position._note: specs/capability-registry.json name=compute dag_node=compute — capability entry carries no grounded stratum yet (deliberately undeclared among pending founder/architecture ruling). forward-declared retained per R4 (TDA-S-RANK-INVERSION).

_tier_source: specs/capability-registry.json name=compute dag_node=compute — capability entry carries no tier/substrate_dag_position (deliberately undeclared among the nine pending founder/architecture ruling). Historical classify-capability-roots authored tier=substrate with forward-declared stratum; retained rather than inventing an S-rank.
_tier_subtype_note: UNGROUNDED — capability-registry declares no tier_subtype and no absorbed legacy service manifest provides one. Deliberately ABSENT rather than invented; it lands when a grounded subtype exists.
_stratum_note: forward-declared retained: ADR-0562 capability-registry still leaves compute undeclared for stratum (unlike messaging, which now carries grounded S0). Restores compute/manifest.json authored on fix/tier-classify-capability-roots (blob 48d13cc8) but never landed on dev; R4 (TDA-S-RANK-INVERSION) treats forward-declared as rank-exempt and cannot manufacture a false GREEN.
_openslo_note: No compute/observability/slos/*.openslo.yaml exists in-tree. OpenSLO refs are omitted rather than invented; SLO authoring lands with a runtime SLI, not this root-manifest slice.
purpose: Owned compute engine substrate (ADR-0562 charter): VM + k8s-on-compute + functions/serverless facade sub-surfaces. The eight workspace crates under compute/ are the domain model, resource kernel, DC ops kernel, cloud-provider adapters, and REST facade APIs — no deployed runtime, measured SLO, or OpenSLO file is claimed by this capability-root slice.

capability_root_accounting._overlap_note: All eight workspace members under compute/ are owned exclusively by this capability root; no absorbed sub-service manifests exist yet.

contracts.contract_status: kernel_and_facade_only; no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/proto contract files exist under compute/ today

foundation_non_claims: this manifest describes the eight crates directly under compute/ and does NOT restate any future absorbed service manifests
no deployed process, served endpoint, measured benchmark, capacity telemetry or audit-chain writer is claimed for the capability root itself

slo_exemption.rationale: The compute/core, compute/adapters and compute/facade crates are capability-level libraries and REST facade stubs with no deployed process of their own, so no measured runtime SLI exists for them yet.
